quote.text: Don’t stray, but do what’s right whenever you’re moved to act, and stick with what’s clear and certain whenever you think.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Always act with clarity and integrity for your children, ensuring that your decisions reflect the right values even when emotions run high.
    • Cultivate a calm mind that can distinguish between impulsive reactions and thoughtful actions, modeling balance for your family.
  • Leadership
    • In moments of uncertainty, lean on clear principles to guide your decisions; steadfast integrity builds trust with your team.
    • Balance passion and careful reasoning to set a consistent example, ensuring your leadership remains both empathetic and resolute.
  • Product Management
    • Identify and follow clear, data-driven strategies even when innovative ideas stir excitement, ensuring that changes are well-considered.
    • Commit to rapid yet thoughtful decision-making, aligning impulsive creative energy with pragmatic, long-term goals to drive sustainable success.
